interactions.label: THE POOL
interactions.dialog: THE DEEP RUN ENDS HERE IN A POOL RINGED WITH STONES. AT DUSK THE LANTERN FROGS COME OUT ON THE LILY PADS, LIGHT UP ONE BY ONE, AND SING. THE ELVES SAY THEY'RE COUNTING THE STARS. THEY GET IT WRONG EVERY NIGHT AND START AGAIN.
